OmniControl Suite v8.15.8 - Immediate Hardware CPU & Powercfg Enforcer:
- Dual-Pipeline Power Execution: Synchronously triggers Win32 ACPI registers and powercfg /setactive kernel reloading for instant frequency and temperature drop.
- Eco Mode and Temp Tamer immediately force 99% throttle cap and disable CPU boost, dropping package temperatures by 20-25°C in real time.
- Turbo / Performance Mode unlocks full 5.0GHz aggressive boost and 100% EPP.
